title.text: KCL Mobile 1.3.1-kcl.5 v3 发布：APK 体积优化至 88MB + JRE 在线补装
KCL Mobile 1.3.1-kcl.5 v3 released: APK slimmed to 88MB + online JRE install

content.text: KCL Mobile 1.3.1-kcl.5（200054）v3 体积优化更新：① APK 体积从 173MB 优化至 88MB——内置 JRE 精简为 Java 8，Java 17/21/25 在需要时首次启动自动联网补装（SHA-256 校验），离线环境仍可启动 Java 8 游戏；② KCL CE 社区版（com.kcl.ce）与 KCL Mobile（com.kcl.pcl）体积同步优化至 88MB，功能完全一致，仍可共存安装；③ 其余 v2 功能不变（导出启动脚本、微软/正版登录皮肤修复、日志持久化、社区大厅/联机、缺 Java 自动补装、下载并发 16 等）。包名 com.kcl.pcl 不变，可直接覆盖安装。下载见 GitHub Release。

KCL Mobile 1.3.1-kcl.5 (200054) v3 size optimization: ① APK slimmed from 173MB to 88MB — the bundled JRE is trimmed to Java 8, and Java 17/21/25 are auto-installed online on first need (SHA-256 verified); offline, Java 8 games still launch; ② the KCL CE community build (com.kcl.ce) is slimmed to 88MB in sync with identical features and still installs alongside KCL Mobile (com.kcl.pcl); ③ all v2 features unchanged (export launch script, Microsoft/premium-login skin fix, log persistence, community lobby/multiplayer, auto Java install, download concurrency 16, etc.). Package com.kcl.pcl unchanged; install directly over previous versions. Download on GitHub Release.
